prompt: Write a NASM x86-64 function that returns the larger of two signed integers.
code:
global larger_value
section .text
larger_value:
    mov rax, rdi
    cmp rdi, rsi
    jge done
    mov rax, rsi
done:
    ret

prompt: Write a NASM x86-64 function that computes the absolute value of a signed 64-bit integer.
code:
global abs_value
section .text
abs_value:
    mov rax, rdi
    neg rax
    cmovl rax, rdi
    ret

prompt: Write a NASM x86-64 function that returns 1 if an integer is even and 0 if odd.
code:
global is_even
section .text
is_even:
    xor eax, eax
    test dil, 1
    setz al
    ret

prompt: Write a NASM x86-64 function that swaps the values pointed to by two integer pointers.
code:
global swap_ints
section .text
swap_ints:
    mov eax, [rdi]
    mov ecx, [rsi]
    mov [rdi], ecx
    mov [rsi], eax
    ret

prompt: Write a NASM x86-64 function that counts the number of set bits in a 64-bit integer.
code:
global popcount64
section .text
popcount64:
    popcnt rax, rdi
    ret

prompt: Write a NASM x86-64 function that returns the minimum of two unsigned integers.
code:
global min_uint
section .text
min_uint:
    mov rax, rdi
    cmp rdi, rsi
    cmova rax, rsi
    ret

prompt: Write a NASM x86-64 function that computes n multiplied by 8 using a shift.
code:
global mul8
section .text
mul8:
    mov rax, rdi
    shl rax, 3
    ret

prompt: Write a NASM x86-64 function that returns the length of a null-terminated byte string.
code:
global str_len
section .text
str_len:
    xor eax, eax
.loop:
    cmp byte [rdi + rax], 0
    je .done
    inc rax
    jmp .loop
.done:
    ret

prompt: Write a NASM x86-64 function that clears the lowest set bit of an integer.
code:
global clear_lowest_bit
section .text
clear_lowest_bit:
    mov rax, rdi
    and rax, rdi-1
    lea rax, [rdi - 1]
    and rax, rdi
    ret

prompt: Write a NASM x86-64 function that returns 1 if a pointer is 16-byte aligned, 0 otherwise.
code:
global is_aligned16
section .text
is_aligned16:
    xor eax, eax
    test dil, 15
    setz al
    ret

prompt: Write a NASM x86-64 function that adds two 64-bit integers and returns the sum.
code:
global add64
section .text
add64:
    mov rax, rdi
    add rax, rsi
    ret

prompt: Write a NASM x86-64 function that rotates a 64-bit integer left by a given count.
code:
global rotl64
section .text
rotl64:
    mov rcx, rsi
    mov rax, rdi
    rol rax, cl
    ret

prompt: Write a NASM x86-64 function that returns the index of the lowest set bit (0-based), or -1 if zero.
code:
global lowest_set_bit
section .text
lowest_set_bit:
    bsf rax, rdi
    jnz .done
    mov rax, -1
.done:
    ret

prompt: Write a NASM x86-64 function that fills a memory region with a given byte value.
code:
global mem_set
section .text
mem_set:
    movzx eax, dl
    mov rcx, rsi
    rep stosb
    ret

prompt: Write a NASM x86-64 function that returns the sign of a 64-bit integer: 1, 0, or -1.
code:
global sign_of
section .text
sign_of:
    xor eax, eax
    test rdi, rdi
    setg al
    setl cl
    sub al, cl
    movsx rax, al
    ret
